component.name: PageForge
component.summary: Batch workbench for PDFs and images

description.p: PageForge applies one tool to a whole batch of PDFs and images, with a live preview: crop, auto-crop, divide into a grid, split and extract pages, organize and merge, convert between images and PDF, rename, upscale, remove backgrounds and run OCR.
Every tool is a plain Python script in a folder you control. The built-in tools can be edited, replaced or deleted, and a new tool is a single file.
First Flatpak release of the GNOME edition. Tesseract is included for the OCR (zones) tool.
